blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Why did a food catering company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte keep winning all 19 contracts in Davao City? Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian repeatedly raised this question when Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte testified as a hostile witness in his sister’s impeachment trial on Tuesday, Sept. 29. Domingo why GenCorp had so many contracts with the LGU, one after another, from 2022 through 2026?” Gatchalian asked, referring to Assistant City Administrator Atty. Tristan Domingo.
